stem: Which sentence from the selection explains why artists first created papel picado?

options.label: A
options.text: People living in Mexico soon had a lot of this tissue paper, and they began using it to make decorations.

options.label: B
options.text: They include images of people, animals, flowers, lettering, and any design that has special meaning to the artist.

options.label: C
options.text: Stacking many sheets of paper allows the artists to create the same pattern on all the sheets at the same time.

options.label: D
options.text: On a papel picado wedding banner, for example, hearts and the names of the bride and groom may be part of the design.
